findings.evidence: Charts.lean:311-316 (`boundaryChartedSpace (hk : k ≠ 0)`), 528-535 (the `∞`-only duplicate instance); mathlib/Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/IsManifold/Basic.lean:780 (`class IsManifold ... : Prop`), :822 `IsManifold.of_le`, :843 `instance : LEInfty (1 : ℕ∞ω)`, :847 `[IsManifold I ∞ M] [LEInfty a] : IsManifold I a M`, :866 `[IsManifold I 3 M] : IsManifold I 2 M`.
findings.fix: Index the charted space on `[IsManifold (𝓡∂ (n + 1)) 1 M]` instead of on `k` and `hk`. `IsManifold` is a `Prop` class, so the instance argument is proof-irrelevant and the structure becomes the unique canonical one; it can then be a real `instance` (no `hk`), found automatically for `C^∞` and `C^ω` manifolds via `LEInfty 1` (Basic.lean:843, 847) and for general `k ≠ 0` via `IsManifold.of_le` (Basic.lean:822). Then drop `instChartedSpaceBoundary`, drop the `letI`s from `isManifold_boundary`, `boundary_boundary_eq_empty`, `isImmersion_boundary_val`, `contMDiff_boundary_val`, `isSmoothEmbedding_boundary_val` and the `chartAt_*` lemmas, and state `isManifold_boundary` for arbitrary `k` with `[IsManifold (𝓡∂ (n+1)) k M]` so `instIsManifoldBoundary` is subsumed rather than duplicated.
findings.issue: `boundaryChartedSpace M (hk : k ≠ 0)` is indexed by `k` and `[IsManifold (𝓡∂ (n+1)) k M]`, but none of its data (toFun/invFun/source/target of `boundaryChart`) depends on `k` — only its proof obligations do. Since a `C^∞` manifold is also `IsManifold I 2 M` etc. (Mathlib instances at IsManifold/Basic.lean:847, 862, 866), `boundaryChartedSpace (k := 2) M h` and the registered `instChartedSpaceBoundary M` are two different `ChartedSpace (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ↥(∂M)` terms (differing in `k`, and `@[irreducible]` blocks unfolding). Results proved in one form are then not usable against the other: `contMDiff_boundary_val (k := 2) M h` cannot be combined with anything stated in the ambient instance. The `letI` plumbing in every downstream statement and the duplicate `instChartedSpaceBoundary`/`instIsManifoldBoundary` pair exist only to work around this.

findings.evidence: Charts.lean:119-121 (def), 132 and 423 (body unfolded in proofs); Model.lean:160-165 gives the parallel `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryProj_apply` for the linear map, and Charts.lean:125-126 gives `euclideanHalfSpaceParam_coe` for the other direction.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem euclideanHalfSpaceProj_coe (y : EuclideanHalfSpace (n+1)) : euclideanHalfSpaceProj n y = euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryProj n y.1 := (rfl)` and `@[simp] theorem euclideanHalfSpaceProj_apply (y) (i : Fin n) : euclideanHalfSpaceProj n y i = y.1 i.succ`, mirroring `euclideanHalfSpaceParam_coe` and `Model.lean`'s `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryProj_apply`, and use them in place of the two internal unfoldings.
findings.issue: `euclideanHalfSpaceProj` is a public `def` with no `_apply`/`_def` lemma, and its body is not exposed (no `@[expose]`; the repo's convention is opt-in, cf. AdditiveGroup/Basic.lean:61). Downstream it is characterized only by `euclideanHalfSpaceProj_param` and `euclideanHalfSpaceParam_proj`, so its coordinates are unreachable off the hyperplane and reachable on it only through a detour, while the file itself unfolds the body twice (`simp [euclideanHalfSpaceProj]` at line 132 and `simp only [..., euclideanHalfSpaceProj]` at line 423). Since the public chart lemma `boundaryChartedSpace_chartAt_apply` is stated in terms of this function, consumers cannot compute in boundary charts without it.

findings.evidence: Charts.lean:311-316 (`@[irreducible]` def with `atlas := range (boundaryChartAt M hk)`), :322 and :333 (`private theorem boundaryChartedSpace_chartAt`, `private theorem boundaryChartedSpace_atlas`); the public lemmas at :346, :358, :370, :382 all concern `chartAt` only.
findings.fix: Add a public `boundaryChartedSpace_atlas : atlas (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ↥((𝓡∂ (n+1)).boundary M) = range (fun p ↦ chartAt (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) p)` (stated via `chartAt`, so the private `boundaryChart` stays hidden), keeping the private `boundaryChartedSpace_atlas` as its proof.
findings.issue: `boundaryChartedSpace` is `@[irreducible]` and its `chartAt` field is characterized publicly, but its `atlas` field is not: `boundaryChartedSpace_atlas` and `boundaryChartedSpace_chartAt` are `private`. Downstream the only atlas fact available is the class's `chart_mem_atlas`, so no consumer can prove `∀ e ∈ atlas _ ↥(∂M), P e` from `∀ p, P (chartAt _ p)` — blocking `isManifold_of_contDiffOn`-style arguments, `HasGroupoid` proofs for other groupoids, and any transition-map reasoning on the boundary, which is exactly what the collar/gluing follow-ups need.

summary: The charted-space structure is indexed by the smoothness exponent k although its data does not depend on k, so a smooth manifold carries two non-interchangeable ChartedSpace structures on its boundary and needs a duplicate instance; separately, the public def euclideanHalfSpaceProj has no characteristic lemma and the atlas of the irreducible boundaryChartedSpace is characterized only by a private lemma.
